name: Daraja Academy
intro: You will take Lesson 1 of “AI for Grandparents” from start to finish — the practice robot, the copy-your-question step and the one-question quiz — then check your progress is kept. Nothing is sent anywhere and you don’t need ChatGPT or Claude.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Daraja Academy” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card changes to “🎉 You’re ready” with a “Let’s go ›” button.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself.

steps.do: Tap “Let’s go ›”. (If the teacher already calls you by a name, another Daraja app on this phone remembered it. That is fine: mark ✅ and go on to step 5.)
steps.see: The course home: “AI for Grandparents”, the teacher asks “What should I call you?”, there is a “Your first name” box, and it says “0 of 6 lessons done”.

steps.do: Without typing anything, tap “That’s me ›”.
steps.see: Nothing moves on, and a short line appears: “Just your first name is fine.”

steps.do: Tap the “Your first name” box, type the name below, then tap “That’s me ›”.
steps.see: The teacher greets you by name (“…, Margaret O'Brien.”) and a big “Start lesson 1 ›” button appears.

steps.do: Tap “Start lesson 1 ›”.
steps.see: “Lesson 1: Just ask it. 🕊” — “You can't break anything. I promise.” — with an “I'm ready ›” button.
steps.tip: The teacher may read the page out loud. Tap “🔊 Read this page to me” if you want it to read again.

steps.do: Tap “I'm ready ›”.
steps.see: A page titled “So… what IS it?” explains AI as a very well-read helper.

steps.do: Tap “Next ›”.
steps.see: “The only rule: talk like a person.” with two example questions, one marked ⭐.

steps.do: Tap “Let me try ›”.
steps.see: “Practice: tap a question. 👇” with three question buttons (🩺, 🎂 and 🍗).

steps.do: Tap the 🍗 question: “I have chicken, rice, and not much energy tonight…”.
steps.see: A little chat appears: your question, then a reply marked “PRACTICE AI” starting “One-pan chicken and rice…”. A “That was easy ›” button appears.

steps.do: Tap “That was easy ›”.
steps.see: “Now ask something REAL. ✍️” with a box to type your question and a blue “📋 Copy my question” button.

steps.do: Without typing anything, tap “📋 Copy my question”.
steps.see: A message box says “Type your question first — anything at all.” Tap “OK”.

steps.do: Tap the question box, type the question below, then tap “📋 Copy my question”.
steps.type: Help me write a note to my sister Ann
steps.see: Below the button, two new buttons appear: “💬 Ask this in ChatGPT →” and “🤖 Ask this in Claude →”. Don’t tap them for this test.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “I did it (or I will!) ›”.
steps.see: “The safety rule. 🛡” — a real AI helper never calls you and never asks for money.

steps.do: Tap “Got it ›”.
steps.see: “One-question quiz. 📞” about a voice like your grandson asking for gift cards, with answers A, B and C.

steps.do: On purpose, tap the wrong answer: “A. Buy the gift cards — it sounded just like him”.
steps.see: Answer A turns red, answer C (“Hang up…”) turns green, and a “Finish the lesson ›” button appears below.
steps.tip: If the purple test-copy bar hides the buttons, scroll down a little.

steps.do: Tap “Finish the lesson ›”.
steps.see: “Lesson 1 done, Margaret O'Brien. ✅” with a list of what you learned and a “Back to the lessons ›” button.

steps.do: Tap “Back to the lessons ›”.
steps.see: The course home says “1 of 6 lessons done”. Lesson 1 has a ✅ and says “done · tap to redo”. There is a “Lesson 2 ›” button.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Still “1 of 6 lessons done”, Lesson 1 still says “done · tap to redo”, and the teacher still uses your name.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap “Lesson 2 ›”.
steps.see: Lesson 2 opens even with no internet: “Lesson 2: Spot the fake. 🛡” with a “Show me the test ›” button.

steps.do: Tap “‹ Lessons”, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: You are back on the course home: “1 of 6 lessons done”, Lesson 2 “Spot the fake” is next, and “🎓 Diploma — after all six” waits at the bottom.
